description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business. 
 
 Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.  
 With its   CodeBeamer   ALM tool, PTC helps clients accelerate and future-proof their product innovation and development processes.   With over 20 years of experience and customers ranging from small & medium enterprises to Fortune 100 companies, we are looking for talented individuals to work on our Java-based web   application .     

 While we do not currently have an open position on our   Code B eamer   Engineering team,   we're   always interested in connecting with talented software engineers who are passionate about building innovative products and solving complex technical challenges.   

 As a Software   Engineer   You'll   have the opportunity to:   

 Design, develop, and enhance modern web applications using Java and Angular   

 
 Build scalable, maintainable, and reusable software components   

 
 Contribute to architectural decisions and technical design discussions   

 
 Develop new features and resolve complex technical challenges   

 
 Collaborate closely with Product Owners, QA Engineers, and Support teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences   

 
 Demonstrate and   showcase   new functionality to teammates and customers   

 
 Participate actively in Agile ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives   

 
 Influence product direction through your technical   expertise   and ideas   

 
   

 What you need to be successful in this role:   

 P rofessional software development experience with Java SE/Angular   

 
 Strong experience building modern web applications   

 
 Spring Framework and Spring MVC   

 

 SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar)   

 
 Git-based version control workflows   

 
 Continuous Integration and modern development practices   

 
 MVC architecture and software design principles   

 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills   

 
 Ability to work effectively in Agile teams (Scrum/Kanban)   

 
 Ownership mindset with a passion for quality and continuous improvement   

 
 Comfortable contributing across the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, testing, documentation, and technical collaboration   

 
 Excellent communication and teamwork skills   

 
   

   

 What we can offer:   

 Long-term financial rewards through our Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) and Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) programs, giving employees the opportunity to share in PTC's success.    

 
 Performance-based annual bonus to recognize and reward individual and company achievements.    

 
 Comprehensive medical (Union) and life insurance (MetLife) coverage to support you and your loved ones.    

 
 Additional   paid time off throughout the year, including birthday leave, volunteer days, and short summer Fridays to help you recharge and enjoy a better work-life balance.    

 
 Paid parental leave of up to   12 weeks   when you are welcoming a new family member     

 
 Home office allowance to help create a comfortable and productive remote working environment.    

 
 SZÉP Card    

 
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)   offering   confidential professional support for personal and work-related challenges.    

 

 Complimentary in-office massage sessions    

 
 Flexible hybrid working model (2 office days/week)    

 
   

 By applying,   you'll   become part of our talent network and be among the first to hear about future opportunities that match your skills and interests. If   you're   excited by our technology, culture, and mission,   we'd   love to get to know you.   Applications will be reviewed and   retained   for future openings, subject to local data privacy regulations.   

   

   

   


   
   

  
  
  
  
 Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you. 
 
 If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?
 
 We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here ."
